mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tax_rules (id, name, country_code, region_code, tax_rate, tax_type, is_shipping_taxable, enabled, priority, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{countryCode}, #{regionCode}, #{taxRate}, #{taxType}, #{isShippingTaxable}, #{enabled}, #{priority}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE tax_rules SET name = #{name}, country_code = #{countryCode}, region_code = #{regionCode}, tax_rate = #{taxRate}, tax_type = #{taxType}, is_shipping_taxable = #{isShippingTaxable}, enabled = #{enabled}, priority = #{priority}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
